chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch.440 – The Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng & A Fragile Pact
chapter_meta_description: Han Li forms a dangerous alliance with the Profound Bone Saint to eliminate Extreme Yin, tempted by the legendary Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng that could boost Nascent Soul formation.
og_title: The Void Heaven Palace's Deadly Gambit
og_description: Han Li weighs the risk of a three-century opportunity against the threat of Extreme Yin—and accepts a fragile pact with a vengeful ghost.
twitter_title: A whispered deal under a jade dome
twitter_description: Han Li teams up with a thousand-year-old ghost against a common enemy, lured by a legendary spirit herb that could change his fate.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary immortal herb infused with world spiritual qi that takes the form of small animals and can burrow through earth to evade capture; extremely rare and prized for its purported ability to aid Nascent Soul formation.
A floating jade palace built by ancient cultivators, a central dungeon of this arc that opens only once every three hundred years and suppresses high-level magic within its halls.

The self-proclaimed former master of Extreme Yin Patriarch's founder; exists as a 'thousand-year-old ghost' in a Profound Soul Body form after sacrificing his physical body and reincarnation for revenge.
A special undead existence where a cultivator disperses their Nascent Soul to bypass physical lifespan limits, permanently sealing the path to reincarnation.
Cultivators from the primordial era whose power and knowledge far exceed those of the modern age; they built enduring structures like the Void Heaven Palace.
The condensed spiritual core formed by a Core Formation cultivator at a higher stage, representing a second life that can survive the destruction of the physical body.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li hesitate to leave?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Void Heaven Palace only opens once every three hundred years; retreating means losing a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for treasures and breakthroughs.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the alliance between Han Li and the Profound Bone Saint trustworthy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. It is a textbook Mortal Stream fragile alliance—built on mutual hatred of a common enemy and a conditional promise, certain to collapse once Extreme Yin is dealt with.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A legendary immortal herb that takes the form of small animals and burrows through earth to escape; the Saint claims it can greatly boost Nascent Soul formation chances.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't cultivators use high-level magic in the hall?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The palace's ancient restrictions suppress any use of mana beyond minor spells, leveling the playing field and preventing internal conflict through pure force.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Will Han Li really help the Saint later?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He agreed only after being promised the ginseng at the second barrier first, and he committed with an implicit escape clause—his help is conditional and likely temporary.
